w: During the evening assembly six little children presented a quiz on Swamini Vato. Then children performed an excellent dance, narrated an incident in English about Ghanshyam Maharaj and performed a drama that highlighted the influence of bad company on a satsangi child. Finally, Swamishri emphasized about the destructive effects of bad things in his blessings.

At 10.00 a.m. Swamishri inaugurated the C. K. Pithavala College of Engineering and Technology by performing pujan of the entrance door and untying the nada-chhadi. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the inaugural assembly.

In the evening Swamishri attended the Sunday satsang assembly in Surat which had a gathering of 22,000 devotees and well-wishers. Pujya Viveksagar Swami discoursed on the Kathopanishad. Thereafter balaks and kishores performed a beautiful traditional dance. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly saying, "Yogiji Maharaj is blessing you all in his divine form for obeying his instructions to attend the Sunday satsang assembly. Everyone is busy with work and it will always be so. But by obeying the commands of the Satpurush one is redeemed forever ..."
Jeffrey H Brickman, District Attorney of Dekalb County, honored Swamishri with a proclamation for his outstanding contribution to nonviolence.

The evening assembly was celebrated as Senior Citizens’ Day. The youths performed a drama ‘Dollar is my God and I am its Servant’ which illustrated the difficult and miserable situations of senior citizens who labored for only money. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the assembly, “If there is Satsang then the family can be happy. The reason for building mandirs here is to maintain your character and culture, to enhance love with family members and to preserve a vegetarian diet in your lives… So you must visit the mandir and read our scriptures.

Atlanta mandir celebrated the Senior Citizens’ Day in the divine presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Senior saints delivered spiritual discourses in the morning sabha. The District Attorney of Dekalb County, Mr. Jeffrey H. Brickman, presented a proclamation to Swamishri that acknowledged the socio-spiritual activities of BAPS and propagation of values such as non-violence.

Charlotte mandal performed an interesting drama - "Dollar Maaro Dev Ne Hu Dollar No Daas" – in the evening assembly, portraying the difficulties of senior citizens of Indian origin in America due to loss of family values. The drama also explained how mandir and satsang can help rejuvenate and preserve family values as taught by the Indian culture. In the end, everyone realized the importance of satsang while singing, "Satsang Maaro Dev Ne Hu Satsang No Daas".

In his blessings at the end, Swamishri explained how mandir helps preserve moral and spiritual values in the older generation and helps to instill them in the younger generation. Swamishri asked the senior citizens to dedicate their retired life to the service of mandir and satsang.

Today, while eating, after sucking a mango and removing the stone, Mahant Swami Maharaj began sucking the juice from the skin. He sucked it from the front part. To suck the back part, he bit off a piece with his mouth. To remove it, Gunvatsaldas Swami immediately held out a saffron tissue, but Swamishri did not put the piece of skin into it. The attendant sadhu, who had come to know Swamishri's preference by now, immediately changed the tissue. He held out a small, used, white tissue. Then the piece went from Swamishri's mouth into it. Without Swamishri saying a word, everyone got a lesson in thrift.

Only yesterday Yogmunidas Swami had requested Mahant Swami Maharaj to send rain, and today it was as if Indra, the god of rain, had understood Swamishri's wish and arrived. The rain was pouring down freely. Swamishri put on his walking shoes, and just then hot gota (fritters) arrived. Swamishri asked the attendant sadhus to take off his shoes so he could offer them to Thakorji. The attendant sadhus requested, "Since you have put your shoes on, let us walk for about ten minutes."

The walk was finished and the shoes were immediately taken off. A plate of hot gota, chutney and chillies was placed in Swamishri's hands. A sadhu sat in front holding Thakorji. Swamishri began the offering, but he started to say something by moving his head and gesturing. No one understood. Swamishri gestured 4 or 5 times, moving his head from left to right...
Meanwhile one sadhu asked, "Shall we move Thakorji towards the chutney?" Swamishri was pleased and nodded yes.
What had happened was that only the gota were in front of Thakorji. The chutney was a little too far away. The plate was arranged according to Swamishri's wish.
Thakorji should not have to bear even the trouble of reaching out his hand. This is Swamishri's supreme devotion. He worships Thakorji with the feeling that he is directly present.

st.t: COVID-19 Vaccination Drives Conducted at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi
w: Supporting the national initiative of getting COVID-19 vaccinated, Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi facilitated the inoculations of 2,000 vaccines over five vaccination drives from February to June 2021.

On behalf of Swaminarayan Akshardham, Dr. J.M. Dave said, “Apollo Hospital under the leadership of Chairman Dr. Reddy conducted wonderful drives that were fast, efficient. Their staff was helpful and prompt at every stage from registration, verification, inoculation and observation. We support and encourage all to get vaccinated.

Drive organizer, Indraprastha Apollo Hospital Managing Director Mr. P Shivakumar, stated, “Apollo is committed to the fight against Covid-19 pandemic in all medical aspects including vaccination drives at our hospitals and on sites. With the immense support of the mandir administration and volunteers the camps were conducted easily and in a few hours.”
